#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Byte-level and Unicode boundary tests."""
import json, subprocess, sys

MAIN = '/workspace/submission/main.py'

def run(payload):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', MAIN], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr[:1000])
    return [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.split(b'\n') if x != b'']

def err(code):
    return {'ok': False, 'error': code}

def tpl(services, rules=b'[]', queries=b'[]'):
    return b'{"services":' + services + b',"rules":' + rules + b',"queries":' + queries + b'}'

CASES = [
    (tpl(b'["a\xff"]'), err('E_JSON'), 'invalid utf8 byte'),
    (tpl(b'["\xc3\xa9"]'), {'ok': True}, 'valid 2-byte'),
    (tpl(b'["\xe2\x98\x83"]'), {'ok': True}, 'valid 3-byte snowman'),
    (tpl(b'["\xf0\x9f\x98\x80"]'), {'ok': True}, 'valid 4-byte emoji'),
    (tpl(b'["\xed\xa0\x80"]'), err('E_JSON'), 'encoded surrogate'),
    (tpl(b'["\xc0\x80"]'), err('E_JSON'), 'overlong nul'),
    (tpl(b'["\xf4\x90\x80\x80"]'), err('E_JSON'), 'above U+10FFFF'),
    (tpl(b'["\xf5\x80\x80\x80"]'), err('E_JSON'), 'invalid lead byte'),
    (tpl(b'["a\x00b"]'), err('E_JSON'), 'raw NUL in string'),
    (tpl(b'["a\\u0000b"]'), {'ok': True}, 'escaped NUL'),
    (tpl(b'["a\\u001fb"]'), {'ok': True}, 'escaped control'),
    (tpl(b'["a\tb"]'), err('E_JSON'), 'raw tab in string'),
    (tpl(b'["a\\tb"]'), {'ok': True}, 'escaped tab'),
    (tpl(b'["\\ud83d\\ude00"]'), {'ok': True}, 'surrogate pair escape'),
    (tpl(b'["\\ud800"]'), err('E_SCHEMA'), 'lone high surrogate'),
    (tpl(b'["\\udfff"]'), err('E_SCHEMA'), 'lone low surrogate'),
    (tpl(b'["\\ud800\\ud800"]'), err('E_SCHEMA'), 'two high surrogates'),
    (tpl(b'["\\udc00\\ud800"]'), err('E_SCHEMA'), 'reversed pair'),
    (tpl(b'["\xc3"],'), err('E_JSON'), 'truncated 2-byte'),
    (b'\xef\xbb\xbf' + tpl(b'["a"]'), err('E_JSON'), 'utf8 BOM'),
    (b'\r', err('E_JSON'), 'bare CR'),
    (b' ', err('E_JSON'), 'single space'),
    (tpl(b'["a"]', b'[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["\\u0041"]}}]'),
     err('E_SCHEMA'), 'escaped token not declared'),
    (tpl(b'["A"]', b'[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["\\u0041"]}}]'),
     {'ok': True}, 'escaped token matches'),
    (tpl(b'["\xc3\xa9"]', b'[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["e\\u0301"]}}]'),
     err('E_SCHEMA'), 'no normalization'),
    (tpl(b'["\xf0\x9f\x98\x80"]',
         b'[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"contains","path":["\xf0\x9f\x98\x80"]}}]',
         b'[["\xf0\x9f\x98\x80"],[]]'), {'ok': True}, 'emoji path'),
    # 64 vs 65 scalars with non-BMP characters
    (tpl(json.dumps(['\U0001F600' * 64]).encode()), {'ok': True}, '64 non-BMP scalars'),
    (tpl(json.dumps(['\U0001F600' * 65]).encode()), err('E_LIMIT'), '65 non-BMP scalars'),
    # combined: valid JSON with an unrelated error later
    (tpl(b'["a","a"]'), err('E_SCHEMA'), 'duplicate service'),
    (tpl(b'["a"]', b'[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"nope"}}]'), err('E_SCHEMA'), 'bad op'),
]

payload = b'\n'.join(c[0] for c in CASES) + b'\n'
got = run(payload)
assert len(got) == len(CASES), (len(got), len(CASES))
fails = 0
for (raw, want, name), g in zip(CASES, got):
    if want == {'ok': True}:
        ok = g.get('ok') is True
    else:
        ok = g == want
    if not ok:
        fails += 1
        print('FAIL %-28s want=%s got=%s' % (name, want, json.dumps(g)[:200]))
print('unicode/byte cases: %d checked, %d failures' % (len(CASES), fails))

# 4-byte emoji semantics end to end
req = {'services': ['\U0001F600', '\U0001F601', 'a'],
       'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'startswith', 'path': ['\U0001F600']}},
                 {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['a', 'a']}}],
       'queries': [[], ['\U0001F600'], ['\U0001F600', 'a', 'a'], ['\U0001F601']]}
out = run(json.dumps(req, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'))
print('emoji request ->', json.dumps(out[0])[:400])
PYEOF
